title: Taylor Series
subtitle: Analysis · Power series approximation
summary: Represents a smooth function as an infinite polynomial centred at a point.
detail:
\[ f(x) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{f^{(n)}(a)}{n!}(x-a)^n \]

At \(a=0\) this is the Maclaurin series. Key expansions: \(e^x=\sum x^n/n!\), \(\sin x=\sum (-1)^n x^{2n+1}/(2n+1)!\), \(\cos x=\sum (-1)^n x^{2n}/(2n)!\). Convergence is governed by the radius of convergence \(R\).
